# Amos Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 335v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/AMO_005_page_001.jpg

---

**5:1** Hear [shimu] this word [ha-davar] which I [am] lifting-up [nosei] over-you, a-lamentation [qinah], O-house of-Yisra'el:

**5:2** "She-has-fallen [nafelah], she-will-not rise [lo tosif qum] again [od] — the-virgin [betulat] Yisra'el; she-is-abandoned [nitteshah] upon her-land [admata]; there-is-none [ein] to-raise-her-up [meqimah]."

**5:4** For thus says YHWH to-the-house of-Yisra'el: "Seek-me [dirshouni] and-live [vichyu]."

**5:5** "And-do-not seek [ve'al-tidreshu] Beit-El [Bethel], and-Gilgal do-not enter [al-tavo'u], and-Be'ersheva [Beersheba] do-not cross-over-to [al-ta'avru]; for Gilgal will-surely-go [galoh yigleh] into-exile [galut], and-Beit-El will-become [yihyeh] trouble [le-aven]."

**5:6** "Seek [dirshu] YHWH and-live [vichyu], lest [pen] he-break-out [yitslach] like-fire [ka-esh] on-the-house of-Yosef [Joseph] and-devour [ve'akhelah], and-there-is-none [ve-ein] to-quench [mekhabbeh] for-Beit-El."

**5:7** "Those-who-turn [ha-hofkhim] justice [mishpat] to-wormwood [la-la'anah] and-righteousness [tsedaqah] to-the-ground [la-arets] cast-down [hinnichu]."

**5:14** Seek [dirshu] good [tov] and-not evil [ra], so-that [lema'an] you-may-live [tichyu]; and-so [vekhen] YHWH, God of-Hosts, will-be with-you as you-have-said [amartem].

**5:15** Hate [sin'u] evil and-love [ve'ehevu] good, and-establish [vehatssigu] justice [mishpat] in-the-gate [ba-sha'ar]; perhaps [ulai] YHWH God of-Hosts will-be-gracious [yechanein] [to] the-remnant [she'erit] of-Yosef.

**5:18** Woe [hoi] to-those-who-desire [ha-mit'avvim] the-day of-YHWH! What [lammah] [is] this to-you, the-day of-YHWH? It [is] darkness [choshekh] and-not light [or].

**5:21** "I-hate [saneiti], I-reject [ma'asti] your-festivals [chaggekhem], and-I-will-not smell [velo ariach] your-solemn-assemblies [be-atsroteikhem]."

**5:22** "Even-if [ki im] you-offer-up [ta'alu] to-me burnt-offerings [olot] and-your-grain-offerings [u-minchoteikhem], I-will-not accept [lo ertsah]; and-the-peace-offerings [shelami] of-your-fatlings [meri'eikhem] I-will-not look-at [lo abbit]."

**5:23** "Remove [haser] from-me the-noise [hamon] of-your-songs [shireicha]; and-the-melody [ve-zimrat] of-your-harps [nevalekha] I-will-not hear [lo eshma]."

**5:24** "But-let-roll [veyiggal] justice [mishpat] like-waters [ka-mayim], and-righteousness [u-tsedaqah] like-a-mighty [eitan] stream [nachal]."

**5:27** "And-I-will-exile [vehigletiti] you beyond [me-hal'ah] Dammeseq [Damascus]," says YHWH — God of-Hosts [is] his-name.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "the virgin Israel":** A lament (*qinah*) — the distinctive 3:2 meter of Hebrew funeral dirges. Amos mourns Israel as if she is already dead.

**v.18 — "Woe to those who desire the day of YHWH":** Israel expected the "day of YHWH" to bring victory. Amos reverses it: the day of YHWH is judgment *on* Israel, not *for* Israel. This reversal is one of the most significant theological innovations in the prophetic corpus.

**v.24 — "Let justice roll down like waters":** The most quoted verse in Amos — and one of the most quoted in the entire Bible. *Mishpat* (justice) and *tsedaqah* (righteousness) as a permanent, powerful flow — not occasional religious observance but a constant, unstoppable force.

*— EMET*
